name: Liza
source:
Rose's body double. She makes initial contact with Siegfried Maired after accepting Leona's offer. Siegfried's reluctance to immerse himself in the sexual norms of noble society forces Liza to implement a training regimen requiring Siegfried to have sex with the household maids and to partake in certain virility boosting foods.

Each time Siegfried visits the capital, Liza puts his sexual experience to the test personally or via proxy.
